entries.definition: A tenth of the increase: "Thou shalt truly tithe all the increase of thy seed, that the field bringeth forth year by year" (Deuteronomy 14:22), given to the Levites for their service (Numbers 18:21) and, every third year, to "the Levite, the stranger, the fatherless, and the widow" (Deuteronomy 26:12).
